text_block_list.text:
While reviewing Bamboo Memory's
upcoming race schedule in the trainer's office—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: —Excuse me!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer!!
Sorry it's so sudden,
but please hear me out on what's bothering me!!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: To put it simply, what does it truly take to prove you're the strongest and most awesome Umamusume!?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
This year, my goal is to become the ultimate, most marvelous Umamusume at my best distance.
But does that mean—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Just challenging G1s, winning them, and having people say
'She's so strong!!'...
I kinda feel like that's not quite enough, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
How should I put it, like... I thought there might be some
clear, visible form, some kind of proof out there...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
“But I just couldn't figure out
what it was...!
And once I started thinking about it, it wouldn't leave my head...!”

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, can you think of anything!?
Something that screams,
'This is proof of the greatest and strongest!!'...!!

It was a difficult question,
but one single thing came to mind
that could fulfill Bamboo Memory's wish—
choice_data_list: There is something that could serve as proof.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!
What on earth is that!?
choice_data_list: It's to become the "Best Sprinter Umamusume".
It means becoming the "Best Sprinter Umamusume".

text_block_list.text:
The "Best Sprinter Umamusume" is one of the URA's
annual award categories, an honor bestowed upon
the one who performed best in sprint races that year.

This will surely serve as sufficient proof
of being the strongest and greatest Umamusume
that Bamboo Memory speaks of...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: "Best Sprint Umamusume"...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I see, so that was an option, boss!!
Ooooh! What a cool-sounding title!
"Best Sprinter Umamusume"!!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
All right!! Trainer!!
I wanna aim for Best Sprinter Umamusume!!

The two GⅠ races that Bamboo Memory
will likely challenge in the future: the Takamatsunomiya Kinen
and the Sprinters Stakes.
If we can win both of these races, it will naturally bring us closest to that honor. That said, if we want to aim for it with greater certainty—

Along with winning two sprint GⅠ races,
she will likely need several more graded sprint victories under her belt...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
—So not only do I gotta win two sprint G1s,
I might also have to win
other graded sprint races too, huh...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
That sounds insanely tough...!
Even so—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Now I'm even MORE fired up!!
Overcoming hardship is what makes glory so sweet!!
It's totally worth aiming for!!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer!!
Let's aim for 'Best Sprinter'
together!!"

In order to win the "Best Sprint Umamusume" title,
I'll need to re-evaluate
our future race plan...!
